name: Chat Channels
description: Global switches and message retention for the Chat Channels toolkit. The per-platform credential panels on the WordPress screen are display-only (they are not in the option's sanitize whitelist), so they are deliberately absent here; configure channel credentials through Connections instead. The default assistant select is omitted because its options come from the assistant store.

settings.label: Enable logging
settings.description: Records inbound and outbound channel activity.

settings.label: Enable rate limiting
settings.description: Applies the channel rate limits to inbound messages.

settings.label: Verify webhook signatures
settings.description: Rejects inbound webhooks whose signature does not match the channel secret.

settings.label: Message retention (days)
settings.description: Messages older than this are deleted. 0 keeps them forever; values are clamped to 0-730.
